name: tep
description: Codex integration guidance for Trust Evidence Protocol local fact ledgers.

interface.shortDescription: Use TEP fact storage, sources, probes, and sealed reasoning ledgers.
interface.longDescription: Guides Codex agents to use Trust Evidence Protocol as a local fact memory: capture inputs and command observations, ingest files as sources, maintain agent-owned sealed ledgers, run ACT-gated probes, and ask TEP for valid next operations instead of writing raw JSON.
defaultPrompt: Start a TEP-backed agent session for this workspace.
Capture this document as a TEP source and extract supported claims.
Validate the current TEP ledger before finalizing the task.
